# Repeatable (10-year cooldown): Twin Eagles bilateral embassy for BYZ/ROM or Rus' on Path 1.
oe_rom3_dec_twin_eagles_embassy = {
    decision_category = religious_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        current_year >= 1490
        global_var:oe_rom3_path ?= 1
        oe_rom3_has_byz = yes
        oe_rom3_has_rus = yes
        OR = {
            oe_rom3_is_second_rome = yes
            oe_rus_country = yes
        }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 80
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_rom3_embassy_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:clergy background = pop_type:nobles } }
    option = {
        name = oe_rom3_dec_twin_eagles_embassy.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -80
            set_variable = { name = oe_rom3_embassy_cd months = 120 }
            add_prestige = 8
            add_religious_influence = 10
            oe_rom3_apply_bilateral_bias = { bias = oe_rom3_b_twin_eagles }
            oe_rom3_apply_bilateral_mod = { mod = oe_rom3_twin_eagles_concordat yrs = 15 }
        }
    }
}

    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        prestige >= 25
        stability >= 0

    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:nobles background = pop_type:clergy } }
    option = {
        name = oe_rom3_dec_claim_third_rome.a
        effect = {

            add_prestige = 20
            add_legitimacy = 15
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_rom3_third_rome_mantle years = 30 mode = replace }

    }
}
